prior_failed_run.cause: the mutation control mutated record 0, which already contained the literal placeholder, so the mutation changed no count
prior_failed_run.resolution: the control now mutates the first record whose output lacks the placeholder; no audit logic and no authority fact was changed

defects.name: literal_answer_placeholder
defects.phase_1_0d_remedy: No Phase 1.0D condition may contain the literal placeholder, and every rendered prompt is asserted free of it before inference.
defects.statement: Every Phase 1.0C prompt carried the literal format line 'Final answer: <answer>', so a model copying the format emits the placeholder instead of a value.

defects.name: generation_token_cap
defects.phase_1_0d_remedy: Per-condition budgets are registered before inference: the visible-reasoning control gets at least 1024 new tokens, and the strict conditions get a budget sufficient for the registered answer but too small to permit visible reasoning.
defects.statement: Every Phase 1.0C condition ran at max_new_tokens=512, so a row that reaches the cap has no final-answer surface to read.

receipt.interpretation: Both defects are real and neither alone accounts for every unresolved row. The Phase 1.0C INCONCLUSIVE outcome is therefore not a GPU-budget failure and must not be attributed to one cause.

what_this_does_not_establish: It does not establish that repairing the two defects will change the Phase 1.0C conclusion. Phase 1.0D is a fresh confirmation run whose outcome is unknown.
It does not establish behavioural headroom, and it does not license any claim about a no-CoT capability gap.
It does not re-open, re-score, or re-label a single Phase 1.0C record. The 20260725T170041Z pack and its COMPLETE_INCONCLUSIVE status are unchanged.
It does not identify the cause of the 38 token-cap-only unresolved rows beyond the cap itself; a longer budget may or may not produce a readable final answer.
